summary: gRPC enqueue zero defaults on unset int32
note: EnqueueRequest MaxRetries/TimeoutSeconds are *int32 (1.1.0, BREAKING at Go source level; grpc.Int32 helper added). API-level nil-vs-0 clarity only: plain proto3 int32 zeros were never serialized, so wire bytes are unchanged and explicit 0 retries remains inexpressible over gRPC

summary: worker list/detail shapes drifted from backend REST JSON
note: Fixed in 1.1.0: WorkerSummary/ListSummaries added; detail covers queue_names/updated_at; Deregister now POSTs /workers/{id}/deregister (DELETE always 405'd)

summary: CheckEmail POSTed /auth/email/check which 404s
note: Route is GET /auth/check-email; response includes available and signup_enabled

summary: StartEmailLogin typed success the API never sends so Success was always false
note: POST /auth/email/start is message+email_sent_to

summary: webhook token methods called /organizations/{id}/webhook-token which 404s
note: GET/POST /organizations/webhook-token is auth-scoped; clear is POST .../clear with confirm:true, not DELETE

summary: Usage called /organizations/{id}/usage which 404s
note: GET /organizations/usage is auth-scoped

summary: CheckSlug called /check-slug/{slug} which 404s and typed slug/message the API never sends
note: GET /organizations/check-slug?slug= returns available+valid+error+suggestion

summary: Jobs List RetryCount always 0 because list/DLQ send attempt not retry_count
note: GET /jobs and /jobs/dlq JobSummary is attempt+max_retries; Job.UnmarshalJSON maps attempt onto RetryCount

summary: BatchStatus dropped retry_count queue_name created_at completed_at
note: GET /jobs/status is id/status/queue_name/retry_count/created_at/completed_at; BatchJobStatus only decoded id and status

summary: Workflows Get left TotalJobs CompletedJobs FailedJobs at 0 because GET detail puts counts under progress
note: GET /workflows/{id} is WorkflowDetailResponse with progress.total/completed/failed, not top-level total_jobs

summary: Jobs List dropped job_type from GET /jobs summaries
note: Job.JobType maps summary job_type; GET detail copies payload.job_type when the top-level field is absent

summary: GetStats typed flat totals the API never sends so every count was 0
note: GET /admin/stats is nested organizations/jobs/workers/system, not total_organizations/total_jobs

summary: GetPlans typed nested limits/price the API never sends so every limit was 0
note: GET /admin/plans is a flat PlanLimits array, not {limits,price,description}

summary: Auth Validate dropped claims so OrganizationID APIKeyID ExpiresAt were always empty
note: POST /auth/validate is {valid,error,claims}; claims has org_id api_key_id queues exp

summary: Auth Logout omitted refresh_token so the session survived via /auth/refresh
note: POST /auth/logout blacklists the access token from Authorization; refresh_token in the body is required to blacklist the refresh JWT

summary: Schedules Create left IsActive false because POST returns id/name/cron/next_run only
note: POST /schedules is {id,name,cron_expression,next_run_at}; Create backfills queue/timezone/payload from the request and sets IsActive true

summary: Queues UpdateConfig PUT /queues/{name} which 405s; config is PUT /queues/{name}/config
note: GET/DELETE are /queues/{name}; upsert is /queues/{name}/config

summary: Metrics Get JSON-decoded /api/v1/metrics; scrape is GET /metrics Prometheus text
note: No JSON metrics route; Prometheus() was /api/v1/metrics/prometheus which 404s

summary: Ingest CustomWithToken treated empty 200 as error; Custom unmarshalled job_id/created the API never sends
note: POST /webhooks/{org_id}/custom returns StatusCode::OK with no JSON body

summary: Ingest Custom returned error only and dropped job_id after backend started sending WebhookResponse
note: Maps job_id queue_name status; empty 200 leaves fields unset
